verdict.rationale: The SOS clearly runs some bulk-data channels: its bizfile page refers to "requestors of Bulk data" receiving files, and it offers a "Download list of active Notaries Public". So some extracts are published without scraping, but the evidence is thin on how bulk business-entity data is obtained, its format, cost and update cadence. Missing for 10: documented bulk business-entity/UCC/trademark extract catalog, file formats and schemas, self-serve vs. request/paid access terms, update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of the downloads.
